notes: The deliverable is an obstacle tower climbed at the player's own pace with reaching the top as the stated win condition, so Obby & Platformer on course-tower, which routes the genre P6 plus P2 for the stacked platforms wrapping the shaft. The Tower Obby preset fits as-is; I added hazard-kill for the volcano event, since rising lava that eliminates on touch is genuinely contact-lethal geometry at the base of the tower. I did not name Action as a second genre even though the reference game's slapping is player-versus-player, because the requirements list and the answers both frame the build as an obstacle-tower map won by climbing. The admin panel, announcements, and the speed, jump, low-gravity, fog, darkness, rain and wind events are UI and runtime effects with no layout footprint, so nothing was emitted for them; the answers confirm the volcanic look is temporary rather than the map's permanent theme.
